title: WINDSHIELD WIPER VAC HOSE ROUTING & VAC TANK MTG
summary: Engine-compartment routing of the windshield wiper vacuum hoses (LH hose assembly plus color-striped red/white/yellow/green hoses to the wiper motor, check valve and headlamp washer) along the generator & front lamp harness, and mounting of the vacuum tank (vacuum reservoir/canister). The tank is held by one screw assembly (View A); the hoses are bundled with straps and held by special clips, one of which is bent to retain the hoses. Related sheet: A13 (headlamp vacuum hoses).

parts.name: HOSE ASM.-W/S WIPER VAC L.H.
parts.name_expanded: Hose assembly – windshield wiper vacuum, LH

fastening.to: body at the vacuum tank mounting location
fastening.note: View A: a single screw assembly [2] goes through the tank's lower mounting flange into the body panel.

fastening.to: flange/bracket at the upper edge, next to the pipe asm. and tee
fastening.note: Special clip [4] hooks over the flange and holds the hose bundle; note A: bend clip as required to properly retain hoses.

fastening.to: other vacuum hoses in the bundle
fastening.note: Straps [5] tie the vacuum hose bundle together at two points toward the wiper motor end.

fastening.to: hose bundle between the two straps [5]
fastening.note: Special clip [6] (eyelet clip with a hole) sits on the hose bundle between the straps; what it mounts to is not clear in the drawing.

notes: A: Bend clip as required to properly retain hoses.
Hoses: RED and WHITE to W/S wiper motor; to check valve; YELLOW, GREEN, WHITE to headlamp washer end; joined with TEE and TAPE; unnumbered CLIPs and TAPE hold hoses along the GEN. & FWD LAMP HARN.
notes_internal: Several unnumbered CLIP and TAPE callouts along the generator & fwd lamp harness have no part numbers; not listed as parts.
Clip [6]: mounting point not readable; described as on the hose bundle.
